shigureni.name: shigureni free illust
shigureni.summary: Free for use in apps and websites. Resizing, cropping, recolouring and flipping are permitted. Redrawing or tracing a derivative illustration is not, nor is any generative-AI use. Up to 5 illustrations free per production for commercial use; ¥1,000 each thereafter.
shigureni.commercialUse: Nine illustrations are used here, which is above the 5 that are free for COMMERCIAL use. Poker Master is a free site with no revenue, so the ceiling does not apply as things stand. If that ever changes, four additional licences are needed — see README.md. The nine unused icon files do not count while nothing references them.

own-work.name: Drawn for this project
own-work.summary: Original artwork made for this repo; no outside terms apply.
